title: Word on an Embedded Tape
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers with $m>0$, let $\iota:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ be an injection, and let $\mathrm{frame}$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $k$ tapes, with the empty word on every tape in the image of $\iota$. For any Boolean word $w$ and every $i<m$, replacing the contents of tape $\iota(0)$ by $w$ gives the standard assignment on $m$ tapes that places $w$ on tape zero and the empty word on every other tape.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from the $m$ tape indices to the $k$ tape indices
Every tape in the image of the injection has empty frame word
An arbitrary frame of Boolean words
